gaps.sentence: The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
The minister was ___ (CRITIC) for her handling of the flooding crisis.
gaps.explanation: 'Be criticised for' = be attacked verbally; the verb form is needed in the passive.

gaps.sentence: The programme aims at the ___ (EDUCATE) of young farmers.
She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.
The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.

gaps.sentence: The refugees celebrated their ___ (FREE) at last.
He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.
'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.
